verdict.rationale: Veriff documents a manual review workflow via the Verifications page in the Customer Portal, decision triggering, decision webhooks, and PDF export of session details, indicating a review queue with decision feedback into the record. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm the reviewer UI surfaces the full evidence bundle (document images + extracted fields + check results) together, nor detail how reviewer overrides propagate back to downstream systems beyond the decision webhook. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the review UI showing document images/extracted fields/check results side-by-side, and confirmation that manual reviewer decisions update the stored verification record accessible via API.
